rig.name: Bob Dylan - Mr. Tambourine Man - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in recording.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean recordings.

blocks.purpose: Gentle compression to even out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios.
blocks.gap: The ideal choice would be a dedicated clean compressor, but Comp provides necessary dynamic control for folk picking.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal path clean and transparent to maintain acoustic clarity.
blocks.gap: N/A. No gain stage is needed for this dry folk tone.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate sound of a vintage American clean amplifier.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best available model for achieving high clarity and low coloration suitable for folk music.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound that complements the clean US Deluxe amp.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is chosen for its clarity, mimicking the direct recording of an acoustic source.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the high-end sparkle and articulate the fingerpicked notes without sounding harsh.
blocks.gap: A slight boost in treble is crucial to replicate the 'air' of an acoustic recording.

blocks.purpose: Bypass the wah pedal to maintain a neutral and dry tone.
blocks.gap: N/A. The effect is intentionally bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Bypass modulation effects to keep the tone dry and natural.
blocks.gap: N/A. The effect is intentionally bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Avoid delay to maintain the dry, immediate feel of a vintage folk recording.
blocks.gap: N/A. The effect is intentionally bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Avoid reverb to maintain the dry, intimate sound of a studio folk recording.
blocks.gap: N/A. The effect is intentionally bypassed.

improvements.summary: The current setup is fundamentally flawed as it uses an electric guitar model for purely acoustic folk material. The primary improvement must be to bypass the amp/cab simulation entirely and focus on pure tone shaping.

proposals.recommendedAsset: High-quality Acoustic IR (e.g., vintage condenser mic)
proposals.reason: The GP-180 must bypass amp/cab simulation to simulate direct acoustic recording.
proposals.expectedGain: Massive improvement in realism and tone accuracy.
